Compatible LRU panic-safety backport — 2026-10-30

Base: lru 0.16.4, MIT, from the crates.io source archive.
Archive SHA-256: 7f66e8d5d03f609abc3a39e6f08e4164ebf1447a732906d39eb9b99b7919ef39
The upstream license, package version, public API and cache format are retained.
This private compatibility copy is not a new upstream release.

Advisory: RUSTSEC-2026-0253
Upstream fix: https://github.com/jeromefroe/lru-rs/pull/238
Applied commit: 2776ded569ee89a99c515bca8194f65639182c96
Merged as: f9a7f00fcf2d33e00adb03758cb350aaaa52cddb
Upstream fixed release: 0.18.2

Production change: the exact upstream LruCache::pop reorder detaches the
intrusive node before freeing its allocation and dropping its key. A panicking
key destructor therefore cannot leave a dangling node in the live list.

Qualification additions:
- The upstream panic-on-Drop regression pattern is retained with assertions.
- A separate before/after probe only compares live-sentinel/pointer identities.
  On the original source it abandons the corrupt cache before failing, so the
  negative test does not intentionally traverse or drop dangling nodes.
- The independent qualification workspace and lockfile pin test dependencies.
- publish=false prevents accidentally publishing this private patched copy.

Run from a consuming AQS checkout:
  cargo test --manifest-path aq-engine/vendor/lru/Cargo.toml --offline --locked
  cargo test --manifest-path aq-engine/vendor/lru/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --offline --locked

The workspace must select this path through [patch.crates-io]. Patches declared
by a dependency are not inherited by consuming Cargo workspaces. Standalone AQE
and the parent AQS workspace therefore need matching patch selection.

The observed Tantivy consumer uses usize cache keys, whose Drop does not panic;
the advisory prerequisite was not demonstrated for that consumer. This patch
fixes the generic library contract rather than suppressing its advisory.
Native before/after and full-suite qualification do not replace Miri checking;
Miri is not installed in the current local toolchain.
